# Security policy

Report suspected vulnerabilities privately to [CONTACT_EMAIL]. Include affected URL or component, impact, and safe reproduction steps. Do not access or modify other users' data, disrupt the service, or publicly disclose an issue before coordinating a fix. We aim to acknowledge reports within five business days and provide a remediation timeline after triage.

For urgent active exploitation, contact the Cloudflare account owner and Stripe support as applicable. Please allow reasonable time for remediation before public disclosure.
